overall_goal: Add sweetcorn, season with Worcestershire sauce and apple cider vinegar, and cook the mixture.

goals.description: Fetch and open the bag of sweetcorn.
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the sweetcorn from the garage freezer, gets scissors, and cuts the bag open.

goals.description: Season the food with Worcestershire sauce and apple cider vinegar.
goals.rationale: The person opens and adds Worcestershire sauce and apple cider vinegar to the pan, stirring them into the food.

goals.description: Add the sweetcorn to the pan and mix it in.
goals.rationale: The person pours the sweetcorn into the pan and stirs and shakes the pan to mix it evenly.

goals.description: Cook and stir the food mixture.
goals.rationale: The person continues to cook the food, stirring, shaking, and scraping the pan to ensure even cooking.
